name: Grafana-Image-Renderer
description: Grafana's remote image renderer: renders panels and dashboards to PNG and PDF with a headless browser, for alerts, reports and sharing. To use it, add these variables to your Grafana container (change the IPs and ports to suit your setup): GF_RENDERING_SERVER_URL=http://[renderer IP]:8081/render GF_RENDERING_CALLBACK_URL=http://[Grafana IP]:3000/ GF_RENDERING_RENDERER_TOKEN=the same value as Auth Token below

variables.name: Auth Token
variables.description: Shared secret with Grafana: set the same value in Grafana's GF_RENDERING_RENDERER_TOKEN. Both default to -; change it to a random string.
